qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for M8 hex screws when attaching the transmission to engine?
What torque should I use for M10 hex screws in the transmission to engine connection?
What is the torque specification for the largest hex screws (M12) used in transmission to engine mounting?
What torque should M8 Torx bolts be tightened to for transmission mounting?
What is the torque specification for M10 Torx bolts in the transmission assembly?
What torque should I apply to M12 Torx bolts in the transmission?
Which hex screw size requires the highest torque for transmission to engine mounting?
qa_pairs.answer: M12 hex screws require the highest torque at 74 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between M8 hex screws and M8 Torx bolts for transmission mounting?
qa_pairs.answer: M8 hex screws use 25 Nm while M8 Torx bolts use 22 Nm, a difference of 3 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection covers these manual transmission torque specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 23-1 Manual Transmission, subsection 23 00 Transmission in general

qa_pairs.question: Do hex screws or Torx bolts generally require higher torque values for the same thread size in transmission mounting?
qa_pairs.answer: Hex screws generally require higher torque values than Torx bolts for the same thread size
